objective: Compile a portable Academy skill that turns a bounded capability subgraph into a free, executable learning mission ending in inspectable artifacts and assessment-ready evidence.

deliverables.description: An Agent Skills-compatible mission graph design package with a defensible completion contract.

context.audience: Academy architects, educators, domain experts, mentors, and project-based learners

stakes.rationale: A defective mission can waste learner effort or expose data, but a draft contract can be rejected before execution.

must: Select the smallest connected capability subgraph needed for the learner-visible outcome.
Map every target capability to observable artifacts and evidence events.
Keep one complete reference mission executable without payment.
mustNot: Issue credentials or translate attendance, opaque scores, or payment status into competence.
Turn sponsor problems into uncompensated learner labor or transfer learner IP by default.
Activate persistent agents without a justified autonomy boundary and human approval.

completionTests.value: Every target capability maps to at least one artifact claim and evidence event.
